articles.summary: The Cádiz CF youth academy has a new reason to celebrate. Jan Saltzman, a center back on the U19 B team, has been called up again to the Sweden U17 National Team, this time to play in the qualifying round of the European Championship in Albania, from November 8 to 18. articles.title: Cádiz CF’s Jan Saltzman Called Up to the Sweden U17 National Team
